title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with access to the configured load balancer account could replace a load…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with access to the configured load balancer account can replace a load balancer helper. This helper is later executed by Splunk SOAR with root privileges during cluster lifecycle operations. Because Splunk SOAR does not verify the integrity or ownership of this helper before execution, an attacker could achieve arbitrary code execution with root privileges if a cluster lifecycle operation is performed by an administrator.
